IC 1101.mass_kind: published stellar mass within the approximate 260-kpc main-body edge (arXiv:2607.15340); game point-mass proxy
IC 1101.uncertainty_note: Deep stellar edge and mass are uncertain; outer intracluster light is omitted. Smooth profile and core gravity are estimates.

UGC 1382.name: UGC 1382
UGC 1382.mass_kind: published stellar-mass estimate, Hagen et al. 2016 (arXiv:1607.02147); excludes dark halo
UGC 1382.uncertainty_note: Very faint outer stellar disk; extent, color and three-component profile are approximate. Stellar mass excludes the dark halo.

UGC 2885.name: UGC 2885
UGC 2885.mass_kind: published stellar-mass estimate, Di Teodoro et al. 2023 as tabulated in arXiv:2410.16467 Table 1; excludes dark halo
UGC 2885.uncertainty_note: Stellar-mass estimates differ; colors, dust and weak pseudoring are approximate. The ordinary spiral pattern is modeled.

NGC 4889.uncertainty_note: Redshift distance and Ks-based stellar mass are estimates; catalog size omits the faint halo. Smooth profile is approximate.

NGC 6166.uncertainty_note: Redshift distance and Ks-based mass are estimates; the larger cluster-bound halo is omitted. Smooth profile is approximate.

_references.selection: Five very large regular galaxies, using starlight extents rather than gas disks or radio lobes; not a uniform top-five ranking.

IC 1101.reference: How large can galaxies be? Ultra-deep imaging of IC 1101 (2026), Sections 4-6
IC 1101.adoption: Use 360-arcsec main stellar diameter, not the approximately 475-kpc-radius diffuse ICL region. Sky position angle remains SIMBAD; a single ellipsoid cannot reproduce the measured isophote twists.

UGC 1382.reference: Hagen et al. (2016), ApJ 826, 210, Section III and Tables 1-2
UGC 1382.adoption: Use 7 arcmin optical/UV diameter, not 220-kpc HI diameter. Intrinsic flattening and single-profile rendering are estimates.

UGC 1382.reference: Saburova et al. (2021), MNRAS 503, 830, compiled properties
UGC 1382.adoption: Use this inclination; derive axis ratio with assumed intrinsic flattening 0.15.

UGC 2885.reference: A multiwavelength overview of the giant spiral UGC 2885, Table 1
UGC 2885.adoption: Use Table 1 mass rather than inventing missing Ks photometry. Size and sky angle remain SIMBAD. Weak resonance pseudoring is not separately modeled.

NGC 4889.reference: McConnell et al. (2011), giant elliptical classification
NGC 4889.adoption: Use SIMBAD main-body isophote; no radio/cluster halo substitution. Mass is the importer Ks mass-to-light estimate, not the black-hole mass.

NGC 6166.reference: Bender et al. (2015), structure and formation of cD galaxy NGC 6166
NGC 6166.adoption: Smooth elliptical approximation to main body; do not include the entire cluster-controlled cD halo as a hard galaxy boundary.
